author: GameTrailers
description: The Sift is in danger! Something ancient is stirring beneath the ground of the new dimension – a threat that has slumbered for ages and is now beginning to wake. Gather your trusty allies, venture deep into unexplored reaches, take on the not-so-happy humblers, and confront the foes behind their rude awakening! The Humblers Awaken is coming December 1.
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official The Humblers Awaken Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Season 5: Dissonant Resonance of Once Human in this latest trailer for the survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world. Once Human is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, and mobile. Season 5: Dissonant Resonance begins in Once Human on November 18, 2026 (PT).
title: Once Human - Official Season 5: Dissonant Resonance Gameplay Trailer
